title: What If All Public Transport Were Free? Luxembourg Did

scenes.text: What if every bus, tram and train were free? Since 2020, one whole country has done it.
On March 1, 2020, Luxembourg made public transport free for everyone, tourists included.
First-class seats and trips across the border still cost money. Only the Luxembourg part is free.
Before it began, the statistics office estimated riders who use only public transport would save about 390 euros a year.
But fares were already low, and reporting at the time found no strict evidence free rides would draw many new riders.
More than 200,000 commuters enter the capital daily, so emptying the roads would take a huge shift.
